g.text: Does failure require a positive movement charge?
Campaign 018: all 80 worlds. Each seed has eight initial treatments; later trajectories may diverge.
Zero charge removes movement energy payment, not occupancy or spatial competition. Every seed and failure is retained.
Finite-horizon outcomes do not establish permanent survival or a unique causal mediator.
